text:
Maria: Kicking off the 18:00 change window deployment for service-b (v2.14.1). Staged rollout to a 10% traffic slice over 10m. Please keep an eye on the SLO dashboards and embeddings route. I’ll post preflight results now.

deploy-bot: Preflight summary: infra=green, cfg-validation=ok, model-serving-baseline_latency=92ms, error_budget=18%. No deployment blockers. Link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/svc/service-b-overview

Sanjay: Noted. Watching p95 and 5xx on /v1/embeds. Running live query.

Alex: Heads up — autoscaler shows pods at 70% CPU on the current slice. If latency climbs we should scale pool by +1 GPU.

deploy-bot: Preflight check logs: 
```
check: kv-cache-health: ok
check: batcher-queue-depth: low
check: model-loads: warm
```

Jamie: Getting an alert from prod-alerts (urgency: low->med): embed-route 5xx rate crossing 0.3% in last 3m. Posting link: https://alerts.redwood.example/alerts/ALRT-3321

Sanjay: Seeing p95 jump to ~420ms at 1705552504 and a small bump in 5xx to 0.35% (5m window). Not huge but worth watching.

Alex: Can we temporarily route new traffic away from the slice while we triage? If 5xx > 0.5% for 5m we should rollback that slice.

Maria: Agreed. For this rollout: if 5xx_rate >= 0.005 (0.5%) sustained over 5m OR p95 > 600ms for 5m -> pause/rollback. Ops, please stand by to execute.

ops-bot: Alert triggered: EMBEDS_5XX_RATE > 0.005 (5m) at 1705552528. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/alerts/embeds-5xx 
Query snippet: 
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"service-b|embeds",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=~"service-b|embeds"}[5m]))
```

Jamie: I'm moving the rollout to pause (traffic shift halted). Notifying deploy-bot to stop further slices.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift paused for rollout v2.14.1 at 1705552535. No further slices will be promoted.

Alex: Initiating rollback for the affected slice to v2.14.0 via release manager. Command: `release-manager rollback --service service-b --slice id=tny-17`

Maria: Good. Please also capture a short postmortem note in the release thread and tag product. We'll keep CS in the loop if user-facing errors are detected.

Sanjay: After the pause + rollback started, p95 trending down to ~130ms and 5xx back to 0.08% at 1705552570.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed for slice tny-17 at 1705552576. All probes green. Estimated downtime for slice: 0.

Alex: Rollback done. Metrics look back to baseline on the slice I watched.

Maria: Thanks everyone — closing the rollout for now. We'll reopen after fix and a new preflight. Filing a short incident note. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-2024-0456 (link: https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-2024-0456)

Jamie: Adding a short follow-up: consider raising the autoscaler cooldown or pre-warming one extra pod for similar model-serving spikes.

Maria: Noted — assigning to eng-runtime for follow-up.

Alex: copied. Closing thread.
